newsitem.title: USA: Roy F. Weston to take $17 mln Q3 charge.
newsitem.headline: Roy F. Weston to take $17 mln Q3 charge.

text.p: Environmental managers Roy F. Weston Inc said on Thursday it would take a non-recurring, pre-tax charge of about $17 million in the third quarter, to reflect write-downs and severance costs.

The company said in a statement the charge included a $10 million write down of its analytical laboratory assets, a $1.6 million write down of its thermal incinerator assets, a $2.4 million write down of other under-performing assets and $3 million for operational reorganizations and severance costs.

"The company is consolidating and focusing its corporate resources on its markets to generate long-term growth by becoming more efficient and effective in the delivery of WESTON's environmental services," WESTON President and Chief Executive Officer William Marrazzo said in a statement.
